description: This teams searches to learn more stuff about NASA while also trying to creat something easy to comprehend.
summary: We decided to make a short stop-motion video combined with traditional frame-to-frame animation. This method was used since; it would be the easiest way to connect with children that have the potential to be future astronauts. Teaching children about NASA's works early could spark an interest in technology and STEM. In conclusion, we wanted to make a way for small children to learn and spark interest in them in NASA's works.
details: All the stop-motion animation was mostly done with paper or thin cardboards. To actually capture the images, we used a free software called "Stop Motion Studio", this software allowed us to easily put all the frames together to make video. We also used a small green screen, a green paper sheet, to capture the effects like the photos flowing in or the asteroids moving across the screen. For all the digital animation we used a free smartphone software called "Flipaclip", we made all the digital animation in it and afterwards pulled all the clips together in Capcut. For most sounds we used free sound websites like "Pixabay" or royalty free music on YouTube.
